Labs","details":"data has the following structure (standard 52-byte strategy header + hook-specific):Standalone RELEASE (LOAN): withdraws collateral from an Aave V4 spoke and nothing else \u2014      no repay leg (this is NOT the MONEY_MARKET AaveV4RedeemHook), no collateral-flag toggle, no      ratio/oracle derivation inside the hook; whether the remaining position stays healthy is      arbitrated solely by the Spoke's health check. The account is both onBehalfOf and receiver.      The account's supplied assets and collateral flag are read before any provider execution is      emitted: an empty position reverts; a position that is not flagged as collateral belongs to the idle      MONEY_MARKET side (ledger-tracked) and reverts RESERVE_NOT_COLLATERAL;      type(uint256).max resolves to the full supplied position and is passed through so the Spoke      withdraws everything natively (the pre-read is the exact expected receipt); an exact word or      previous-hook output above the position reverts \u2014 Aave would otherwise silently convert it      into a full withdrawal. Note the supply credit sits BELOW the pledge by the provider's share      round-trip rounding (assets \u2192 shares rounds down, shares \u2192 assets rounds down again; the gap      depends on the exchange rate \u2014 1 wei for 1 WETH and 2 wei for ~1.0000000000000019 WETH were      observed on the live Main Spoke, so it is NOT a fixed 1-wei bound), so an exact word equal to      the pledged amount is above the position in the same block: size an exact release from      getUserSuppliedAssets or use the sentinel. With usePrevHookAmount the      calldata word (max or otherwise) is ignored and the previous hook's output (denominated in      the collateral token) becomes the amount, so the sentinel is only reachable with      usePrevHookAmount = false. Publishes the measured collateral-token wallet delta with      outToken = collateralToken.Mode marker caveat: \"flag true\" is taken as LOAN mode. Every recompiled Superform hook that sets the      flag (PLEDGE, composite OPEN V2, V1 Supply / SupplyAndBorrow) refuses an un-flagged idle position      (RESERVE_HAS_IDLE_POSITION), but the flag can still be set over one by a direct      setUsingAsCollateral(true) self-call or by the pre-SUP-21143 deployed OPEN V2 / V1 addresses; after that      a RELEASE(max) pays the merged position out with no ledger outflow. amountRoles(bytes).details: Single produced-token slot: the released collateral flows OUT of the provider to the      wallet

params.data: The hook-specific calldata (same as passed to decodeAmounts)

returns.meta: Array of AmountMeta structs aligned index-by-index with decodeAmounts

build(address,address,bytes).details: Standard build pattern - MUST include preExecute first, postExecute last

params.account: The account to perform executions for (usually an ERC7579 account)
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

returns.executions: Array of Execution structs defining calls to make

decodeAmounts(bytes).details: Single-slot default for the single-leg hooks (REPAY, PLEDGE, BORROW, RELEASE): amount1 lives at      offset 176 (not the Morpho-shaped 132). STRICT: runs the full decode (exact length, addresses, header      key, canonical bool, reserved secondary word) so an off-chain sizer can never size or rewrite a payload      that build() / inspect() reject. Composite hooks override with two-slot versions of the same strictness.

returns.amounts: Array of amounts (length 1 for single-amount hooks, 2+ for compound hooks)

decodeUsePrevHookAmount(bytes).details: Aave V4 V2 layout stores usePrevHookAmount at offset 240 (not the Morpho-shaped 196).      Exact-length guard + strict canonical-boolean read so this view never disagrees with      execution-time decoding on malformed data (custom error instead of an OOB panic).

returns._0: True if the hook should use the previous hook's output amount

getCollateralTokenAddress(bytes).details: Used to identify which asset is being used to secure the loan

params.data: The hook-specific data containing collateral information

returns._0: The address of the collateral token

getCollateralTokenBalance(address,bytes).details: Returns the plain wallet balance (not the collateral posted on the lending protocol).      Hooks snapshot this before execution and measure the post-execution delta to report      actual collateral tokens spent (supply) or received (withdraw).

params.account: The account to check the wallet balance for
params.data: The hook-specific data containing the collateral token address

returns._0: The account's wallet balance of the collateral token

getLoanTokenAddress(bytes).details: Used to identify which asset is being borrowed from the lending protocol

params.data: The hook-specific data containing loan information

returns._0: The address of the borrowed token

getLoanTokenBalance(address,bytes).details: Returns the plain wallet balance (not the outstanding debt on the lending protocol).      Hooks snapshot this before execution and measure the post-execution delta to report      actual loan tokens received (borrow) or spent (repay).

params.account: The account to check the wallet balance for
params.data: The hook-specific data containing the loan token address

returns._0: The account's wallet balance of the loan token

getOutAmount(address).details: This is the primary output value used by subsequent hooks

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The amount of tokens (assets or shares) processed

getOutToken(address).details: Used by subsequent hooks to determine what token the previous hook produced      PASSTHROUGH hooks auto-forward the previous hook's outToken      TRANSFORM hooks set this to their specific output token

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The address of the output token, or address(0) if not set
The arguments of the hook encoded

postExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called after the main execution, used to update hook state and calculate results      Sets output values (outAmount, usedShares, etc.) for subsequent hooks

params.account: The account operations were performed for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

preExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called before the main execution, used to validate inputs and set execution context      This method may perform state changes to set up the hook's execution state

params.account: The account to perform operations for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

replaceCalldataAmounts(bytes,uint256[]).details: Single-slot default replacing amount1 at offset 176 after the strict decode; the header, the reserved      secondary word and the boolean byte are left untouched, so the result still decodes

params.amounts: The amounts to replace (must match length from decodeAmounts)
params.data: The data to replace amounts in

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setExecutionContext(address).details: Used for security validation between preExecute and postExecute calls

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setOutAmount(uint256,address).details: Used for updating `outAmount` when fees were deducted

params.caller: The caller address for context identification
params.outAmount: The amount of tokens processed by the hook

subtype().details: Used to categorize hooks beyond the basic HookType      For example, a hook might be of type INFLOW but subtype VAULT_DEPOSIT

returns._0: A bytes32 identifier for the specific hook functionality

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Hooks that implement ISuperHookInflowOutflow/ISuperHookOutflow override      _supportsSizingInterface() to return true, which enables three-state detection:      S1: supportsInterface(ISuperHookInflowOutflow) == true → hook has sizing interface      S2: same as S1 but amountRoles(data).length == 0 → authoritatively sizeless      S3: supportsInterface(ISuperHookInflowOutflow) == false → legacy, no sizing interface
